headline: GIC Re appoints two bank EDs as non-exec directors
summary: General Insurance Corporation of India appointed S K Majumdar and Pramod Kumar Dwibedi as Non-Executive Directors. Both are Executive Directors at Canara Bank and Bank of India respectively.

headline: Dilip Buildcon wins ₹419.47 crore Gurgaon metro order
summary: Dilip Buildcon received a ₹419.47 crore Letter of Acceptance from Gurugram Metro Rail Limited for a depot-cum-workshop project with a 21-month completion period.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Oriana Power, Ashoka Buildcon, Coal India in focus
summary: Oriana Power rallies on Gobardhan approvals while Ashoka Buildcon faces Saudi project cancellation. Coal India files RHP for Mahanadi IPO as Dilip Buildcon secures metro orders.

headline: Prestige Estates launches ₹5,500 mn North Bengaluru project
summary: Prestige Estates Projects Limited launched Prestige Avon in North Bengaluru with a GDV of ₹5,500 million. The 3-acre residential project comprises 260 apartments.

headline: Jupiter Wagons wins order worth over ₹128 crore
summary: Jupiter Wagons has secured another order exceeding ₹128 crore from JSW (South) Rail Logistics, adding to its order book in the rail freight segment.

headline: Natco Pharma gets USFDA EIR with VAI status for Vizag plant
summary: Natco Pharma received a USFDA Establishment Inspection Report with Voluntary Action Indicated status for its Vizag facility following an inspection held August 17-21, 2026, which had yielded four Form 483 observations.

headline: Highway Infrastructure wins ₹198.31 crore CISF project
summary: Highway Infrastructure has received an approval letter for a ₹198.31 crore CISF Battalion Infrastructure Project, marking a significant order win for the company.

headline: Skipper targets ₹7,500 crore order inflows in FY27
summary: Skipper aims for 35% growth in FY27 order inflows to ₹7,500 crore, backed by a record order book of ₹10,066 crore and strong export expansion plans.

headline: Diamond Power secures ₹708 crore HVDC contract
summary: Diamond Power Infrastructure secured a ₹708 crore contract from Adani Energy for a 6,000 MW HVDC green energy project, marking a significant order win.

headline: Rising LNG prices squeeze city gas distributors' margins
summary: Rising LNG prices and supply issues have weighed on city gas distributors' profitability, with Indraprastha Gas reporting an EBITDA loss amid the pressure.

headline: Juniper Green Energy starts 94.77 MWh BESS
summary: Juniper Green Energy has commissioned a 94.77 MWh Battery Energy Storage System, taking its total operational capacity to 698 MWh.

headline: Wanbury's Tanuku API facility clears South Korea MFDS CGMP inspection
summary: Wanbury's Tanuku API facility has successfully passed the South Korea MFDS CGMP inspection without any observations, marking a key regulatory milestone.

headline: Schneider Electric Infra appoints Deepika Srivastava as CS
summary: Schneider Electric Infrastructure Ltd appoints Deepika Srivastava as Company Secretary effective Jan 1, 2027. She succeeds Sumit Goel who resigned to pursue a career outside the group.

headline: Blue Cloud launches sovereign AI call dispatcher
summary: Blue Cloud Softech Solutions launched BluVaani, a sovereign edge AI call dispatcher for police helplines. The solution processes data on-premises without internet, handling 8,500+ calls in pilot.

headline: Tanvi Foods enters ₹600 crore integration with Mitra FMCG
summary: Tanvi Foods (India) Limited has entered a strategic understanding with Mitra FMCG for a business integration valued at approximately ₹600 crore, aiming to expand market reach and supply chain efficiency.

headline: M&M shares worth ₹35 crore change hands in large trade
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 1,00,000 Mahindra & Mahindra shares on BSE at ₹3,500.00 per share, with a combined value of ₹35.00 crore.

headline: Hexaware Tech targets long-term double-digit growth
summary: Hexaware Technologies plans to sustain long-term double-digit growth while targeting faster growth in the medium term, according to an interview with company leadership.

headline: Hyundai Motor India to host analyst meet Nov 26
summary: Hyundai Motor India Limited will hold an investor and analyst meeting on November 26, 2026, at 3:00 pm. The session, organized by ICICI Securities, will be conducted at the company's headquarters.

headline: Tips Music to host analyst meet at Kotak Midcap Conference
summary: Tips Music Limited officials will participate in the Kotak Midcap Conference 2026 on November 27, 2026, for one-on-one and group meetings with investors.

headline: Hyundai Motor India RTA address change
summary: KFin Technologies, the RTA for Hyundai Motor India, shifts its corporate office to Hyderabad effective December 1, 2026. Investors must update records.

headline: Meesho shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 2,135,302 Meesho shares changing hands on NSE at ₹260.86, with a combined value of ₹55.70 crore.

headline: SEBI's Murty urges boards on acquisition risks
summary: SEBI's Murty emphasizes that corporate governance relies on shareholders, the board, and management. He warns that alignment with management should not equate to blind agreement during major acquisitions.

headline: Loyal Textile Mills director R Kannan retires
summary: Loyal Textile Mills Ltd announced the retirement of Independent Director R Kannan following the completion of his second term. The cessation is effective November 19, 2026.

headline: Mizzen Ventures promoter exits fully via open market
summary: Hiren Kishore Deshpande sold his entire 1.50% stake in Mizzen Ventures Ltd on November 19, 2026, reducing his holding to zero.

headline: Counter Cyclical Investments cuts stake in Cochin Minerals
summary: Counter Cyclical Investments Private Limited reduced its holding in Cochin Minerals and Rutile Ltd by 11,135 shares via open market sales on November 17, 2026.

headline: HDFC MF cuts stake in Vardhman Textiles to 5.204%
summary: HDFC Mutual Fund reduced its holding in Vardhman Textiles by 2.008% via open market sales on November 17, 2026, bringing its aggregate stake down to 5.204%.

headline: Padmanabh Alloys promoter buys 500 shares
summary: Hemal Rajeshbhai Desai, a promoter of Padmanabh Alloys & Polymers Ltd, acquired 500 equity shares in the open market on November 18, 2026.

headline: Gabriel India appoints Dimple Chauhan as interim KMP
summary: Gabriel India Limited appointed Dimple Chauhan as Key Managerial Personnel and Compliance Officer on an interim basis effective November 20, 2026.

headline: NRB Industrial Bearings faces court interim order on trademark
summary: A court has issued an interim order restricting NRB Industrial Bearings from using the 'NRB Industrial' mark on automotive bearings, while permitting other marks for mobile vehicle bearings. No monetary claim was made.

headline: A-One Steels reports insider trading violations
summary: A-One Steels India Limited reported two insider trading violations by designated persons during the trading window closure. Both individuals sold shares allotted via IPO.

headline: Goldman Sachs exits substantial stake in Gokaldas Exports
summary: Goldman Sachs Asset Management International reduced its holding in Gokaldas Exports to 2.770% after selling shares on November 17, 2026.

headline: NCL Industries promoter releases pledged shares
summary: Promoter G.T. Sandeep released 14,000 pledged shares of NCL Industries on November 13, 2026, reducing encumbered holdings to 9,722 shares.

headline: Asian Paints approves trading plan for designated person
summary: Asian Paints approved a trading plan for Pinkal Kumar Patel to sell 765 shares between March 23 and 30, 2027, at a minimum price of ₹2,300 per share.

headline: Dynemic promoter acquires warrants, holding hits 6%
summary: Rameshkumar Bhagwandas Patel acquired 4,000 warrants in Dynemic Products Ltd via market purchase, raising his total holding to 6.00% of voting capital.

headline: Atvo promoter group buys 20,000 shares
summary: Naresh Gattani HUF acquired 20,000 equity shares of Atvo Enterprises in the open market on November 17, 2026, raising its stake to 2.82%.

headline: Foodlink F&B Holdings IPO: ₹567 Cr Revenue
summary: Foodlink F&B Holdings files DRHP for IPO. Revenue grew to ₹567.50 crore in FY2026. Proceeds fund new kitchens and banquets. H1 FY2027 saw a net loss.

headline: GIC of India shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 20,06,298 GIC of India shares changing hands on BSE at ₹332.00, with a combined value of ₹66.61 crore.

headline: SEBI chief on boosting corp bond market liquidity
summary: SEBI's head stated the regulator is working with RBI and the Finance Ministry to improve liquidity in the corporate bond secondary market.

headline: Niraj Cement promoter Gulshan Chopra raises stake to 44.53%
summary: Gulshan Vijaykumar Chopra acquired a 19.60% stake in Niraj Cement Structurals, lifting his holding to 44.53% via off-market transfer.

headline: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO Day 2: 0.45x subscribed
summary: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO reaches 0.45x overall subscription on Day 2. QIB leads at 1.26x while Retail and NII categories remain below 0.20x. Issue closes on November 23, 2026.

headline: Crystal Crop IPO Day 3: 4.35x Subscribed
summary: Crystal Crop Protection IPO closed with 4.35x overall subscription. NII sHNI led demand at 7.22x, while QIBs subscribed 2.19x. Listing expected on Nov 26.

headline: ICICI Prudential cuts GSPL Transmission stake below 5%
summary: ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund reduced its holding in GSPL Transmission to 3.745% after a net sale of 62.58 lakh shares, crossing the 5% regulatory threshold.

headline: Dhunseri Tea approves $0.5 mn NCD subscription
summary: Dhunseri Tea & Industries board approved subscribing to NCDs worth USD 0.5 million from subsidiary Dhunseri Petrochem & Tea Pte Ltd on Nov 20, 2026.

headline: ADC India appoints Lavanya Ashok as Independent Director
summary: ADC India Communications appointed Lavanya Ashok as an Additional Director (Independent) for a five-year term effective November 20, 2026.

headline: Kronox Lab pledges 50% stake to Poonawalla Fincorp
summary: Kronox Lab Sciences pledged 1.86 crore shares (50.26%) to CTL Trusteeship for Poonawalla Fincorp. Total encumbered holding rises to 64.26% of equity.

headline: Intellect Design Arena wins two Datos Insights awards
summary: Intellect Design Arena Ltd won two awards at the Datos Insights Wealth Management Impact Awards 2026 for innovation in retirement planning and AI operational automation.

headline: Sita Enterprises seeks shareholder nod for name change
summary: Sita Enterprises Limited has dispatched a postal ballot notice on November 20, 2026, seeking shareholder approval for four special resolutions including a proposed name change to Unicrest Finance Limited.

headline: DJ Mediaprint promoter pledges 5.48% stake
summary: Dinesh Muddu Kotian pledged 19,69,611 shares of DJ Mediaprint & Logistics to Satin Finserv as loan collateral.

headline: SBI MF cuts Neogen Chemicals stake to 1.99%
summary: SBI Mutual Fund reduced its holding in Neogen Chemicals to 1.99% after selling 6,48,272 shares on November 18, 2026, dropping below the 2% threshold.

headline: Raama Finance promoter pledges 5.78% stake
summary: Akhil Mittal pledged 52,50,000 shares of Raama Finance Ltd to Mufin Green Finance. Total encumbered promoter holding rises to 10.08% of share capital.

headline: Clinitech promoter buys 2,400 shares
summary: Jagdish Umakant Nayak acquired 2,400 equity shares of Clinitech Laboratory Ltd in open market on Nov 19, 2026, raising promoter holding to 64.73%.
